tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background on every site: #0B0D0E, one step darker than the eyesclosed editor bg (#111214), which stays the terminal/editor ground. The only ground on the web; nothing sits below it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: code blocks, notes, kbd keys, image wells, hover fill of plain buttons. One step above page; never stack a surface on a surface.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the copy button, which sits on surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The only hairline: between table body rows. Everywhere else, space separates.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of kbd keys. Nothing else.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons and inputs: 3.2:1 on page, 2.8:1 on surface, so put controls on page.

tokens.name: ink-bright
tokens.usage: Strongest ink: hero name, site name, entry titles, strong text, every hover, primary button fill. 14.1:1 on page, 12.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-heading
tokens.usage: Headings h1 to h3 on page and surface. 13.2:1 on page, 11.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy on page and surface. 10.3:1 on page, 9.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: lede, entry descriptions, nav at rest, plain buttons. 5.9:1 on page, 5.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Labels and small print on page only: section labels, entry dates, table heads, sidebar groups, captions, footer. 4.9:1 on page; 4.3:1 on surface misses 4.5, so on a surface use ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Decorative glyphs only, like the $ prompt in commands. 3.2:1 on page; never words someone must read.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in prose, underlined with link-line. 11.7:1 on page.

tokens.name: link-line
tokens.usage: Resting underline under link text; becomes currentColor on hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one cool accent: note labels and small marks. 6.6:1 on page, 5.8:1 on surface. Marks, not paragraphs.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The one warm highlight, at most once per view: a version tag, a match, a 'new' label. 13.9:1 on page.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Inline code in prose. 12.2:1 on page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 3px offset, on every focusable element. 11.7:1 on page, 10.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: ::selection background on every site.

tokens.name: selection-ink
tokens.usage: ::selection text, on selection-bg (7.3:1).

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink-bright fill (the primary button). 14.1:1, and 10.3:1 on its ink hover.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page/editor background; the ground every contrast ratio is measured against.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Statusline, popups, menus, help (Helix ui.statusline/ui.popup/ui.menu).

tokens.name: cursorline
tokens.usage: Cursor-line highlight and rulers.

tokens.name: indent
tokens.usage: Indent guides and visible whitespace.

tokens.name: md-rule
tokens.usage: Markdown horizontal rules.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selection background (Helix and Ghostty).

tokens.name: focus-bg
tokens.usage: Focused row in pickers and menus, preview line; pair with function text in bold.

tokens.name: linenr
tokens.usage: Line numbers, inactive statusline text, window borders. 1.7:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: inlay
tokens.usage: Inlay hints, set in italic. 2.4:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: linenr-active
tokens.usage: Current line number; secondary cursors. 6.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: status-fg
tokens.usage: Statusline text. 6.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: mode
tokens.usage: Normal-mode badge background, bg text in bold on it. 6.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: Primary cursor (neutral gray) with bg text on it; jump labels. 12.0:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default foreground text (Helix ui.text, Ghostty foreground). 9.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: constant
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans, nil, ALL_CAPS constants; fuzzy-match letters in pickers (bold). Brightest syntax token. 13.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: escape
tokens.usage: Escape sequences inside strings (\t, \n), bold. 13.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: function
tokens.usage: Function and method names; focused-row and selected-menu text. 12.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: string
tokens.usage: String and char literals. 11.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: type
tokens.usage: Types, enum variants, constructors. 10.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: macro
tokens.usage: Macros (println!, vec!), italic. 10.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: variable
tokens.usage: Local variables. 9.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: parameter
tokens.usage: Function parameters. 9.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: lifetime
tokens.usage: Labels / Rust lifetimes ('a), italic. 9.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: property
tokens.usage: Fields and .member access. 7.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: builtin
tokens.usage: Builtin types (int, string, usize). 7.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: selfvar
tokens.usage: self / Self and other builtin variables, italic. 6.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (fn, func, return, if), bold. 6.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: namespace
tokens.usage: Namespaces (std::, fmt.). 6.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: operator
tokens.usage: Operators (+= -> :=). 5.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: doc
tokens.usage: Doc comments (///), italic. 5.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: attribute
tokens.usage: Attributes (#[derive]). 4.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: comment
tokens.usage: Comments, italic. 3.6:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: punct
tokens.usage: Brackets, commas, semicolons. 3.1:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: md-bold
tokens.usage: Markdown bold, set bold. 13.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-heading
tokens.usage: Markdown headings, bold. 12.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-code
tokens.usage: Inline code and code blocks (markup.raw). 11.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-link
tokens.usage: Link text, underlined. 11.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-italic
tokens.usage: Markdown italic, italic. 9.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-quote
tokens.usage: Block quotes, italic. 5.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-hmark
tokens.usage: Heading markers (#). 5.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-list
tokens.usage: List bullets and numbers. 6.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: md-url
tokens.usage: Link URLs. 3.1:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: md-fence
tokens.usage: Code fences (defined in the Helix palette; no scope maps to it yet). 3.1:1 on bg. Below 4.5:1 by design (recessive text); don't use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error diagnostics: bold text, curly (wavy) underline. 10.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning diagnostics: bold text, dashed underline; also the insert-mode badge. 6.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info diagnostics: bold text, dotted underline. 8.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: Hint diagnostics: bold text, dotted underline. 4.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Diff gutter: added lines (blue, not green).

tokens.name: modified
tokens.usage: Diff gutter: changed lines.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Diff gutter: removed lines (orange-rose, not red).

tokens.name: ansi-0
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 0 (black).

tokens.name: ansi-1
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 1 (red). 8.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-2
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 2 (green). A muted teal, so it never depends on red vs green. 7.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-3
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 3 (yellow). 11.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-4
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 4 (blue). 8.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-5
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 5 (magenta). Git branch; dim so it differs from cyan by brightness. 5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-6
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 6 (cyan). Prompt paths; bright so it differs from magenta by brightness. 13.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-7
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 7 (white). 10.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-8
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 8 (bright black).

tokens.name: ansi-9
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 9 (bright red). 10.0:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-10
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 10 (bright green). 9.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-11
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 11 (bright yellow). 13.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-12
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 12 (bright blue). 11.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-13
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 13 (bright magenta). 7.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-14
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 14 (bright cyan). 15.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-15
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 15 (bright white). 15.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: prompt-dir
tokens.usage: Starship directory segment. 12.5:1 on bg.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the site or product name in the hero. ink-bright.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title (h1) of a docs or content page. ink-heading.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A native macOS terminal that remembers.
styles.usage: The hero's one sentence and a docs page's standfirst. ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Macterm restores every project, tab and split exactly where you left it.
styles.usage: All running text: intros, docs, feature descriptions, tree lists. ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons (500), nav, sidebar links and page nav (400). ink-muted at rest, ink-bright on hover.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels, note labels, feature numbers, table heads. ink-faint or accent, on page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer, image captions. ink-faint on page.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks only (and inline code at 0.875em). The one place Fira Code appears. ink, syntax tokens on top.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Space is the separator: almost nothing on these pages has a border.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons; between a heading and its text; list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Code block vertical padding; figure-to-caption gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Code block horizontal padding; button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Nav gap; between pagenav links.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header padding; sidebar group gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections; above an h2 in prose.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above the docs pagenav.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on phones; space above the footer.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Hero top padding from 720px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks, notes, kbd, the copy button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media: screenshots, video, photos.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only. The one round shape on a page of rectangles, so actions are found at a glance.

size.note: The one grid every page uses: label column, gutter, text column.

tokens.name: width-label
tokens.usage: Left column: section labels, the site name in the header, the docs sidebar, the footer name.

tokens.name: width-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between the label and text columns.

tokens.name: width-text
tokens.usage: Text column: all reading, entries, code, media (unless it spans the full page).

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Whole grid: label + gutter + text. Media with ec-span fills it.
